title: Reminders
summary: Create reminders with a date, and tick them off when they are done.

steps.title: Add the header
steps.objective: Start the Reminders screen with a title bar.
steps.concept: A header sits at the top of a screen and tells people where they are.
steps.expected: A title bar appears at the top of the phone.

expect.label: A Header sits in the Header zone of Reminders
expect.fail: Drag the Header tool onto the glowing Header zone.

hints: Find the glowing Header tool in the toolbox on the left.
Drag it onto the glowing Header zone of the phone.
On a touch screen: tap Header, then tap the glowing Header zone.

steps.title: Name your screen
steps.objective: Give the screen a clear title.
steps.concept: The header will say “Reminders”. A clear title means nobody gets lost.
hints: Click the header on the phone to select it.
Edit Text content in the Properties panel.
Type exactly: Reminders

steps.title: Add the reminder list
steps.objective: Place the list that shows saved reminders.
steps.concept: A list shows everything saved in one collection. This list is connected to a collection called reminders, and it highlights reminders that are due.
steps.expected: A list panel appears in the Body zone.

expect.label: A List sits in the Body zone of Reminders
expect.fail: Drag the List tool onto the glowing Body zone.

hints: Find the glowing List tool in the toolbox on the left.
Drag it onto the glowing Body zone of the phone.
On a touch screen: tap List, then tap the glowing Body zone.

steps.title: Add the New Reminder button
steps.concept: The button will open the form where a reminder is typed in.
steps.expected: A button appears in the Action bar.

expect.label: A Button sits in the Action bar of Reminders
expect.fail: Drag the Button tool onto the glowing Action bar.

hints: Find the glowing Button tool in the toolbox on the left.
Drag it onto the glowing Action bar of the phone.
On a touch screen: tap Button, then tap the glowing Action bar.

steps.title: Label the button
steps.concept: The label says what will happen, and commands find the button by its label.

expect.label: The button says exactly: New Reminder

hints: Click the button on the phone to select it.
Edit Text content in the Properties panel.
Type exactly: New Reminder

steps.title: Open the next screen
steps.concept: NAVIGATE TO moves your workspace to the New Reminder screen so you can build it.
steps.expected: The phone shows the New Reminder screen.

expect.label: You are on the New Reminder screen

hints: NAVIGATE TO changes the screen you are building.
Put the text inside straight quotation marks.
Copy the command from the step card exactly, then press Run Commands.

steps.title: Add the reminder box
steps.objective: Create a text box for the reminder.
steps.concept: This text becomes the title of the reminder in the list.

expect.label: A text box called What to remember exists

hints: ADD INPUT creates a text box.
Put the text inside straight quotation marks.
Copy the command from the step card exactly, then press Run Commands.

steps.title: Add the date picker
steps.concept: A date picker makes sure people give a real date. The reminder list uses it to find reminders that are due.
steps.expected: A date field labelled When appears.

expect.label: A date picker called When exists

hints: ADD DATE creates a date picker.
Put the text inside straight quotation marks.
Copy the command from the step card exactly, then press Run Commands.

steps.title: Add a Save button
steps.objective: Create a button that stores the reminder.
steps.concept: SAVE "reminders" stores the boxes on this screen as a reminder in the collection called reminders.
steps.expected: The Save Reminder button is ready.

expect.label: Save Reminder is set to SAVE reminders

hints: Add the button first, then give it an action.
Put the text inside straight quotation marks.
Copy the command from the step card exactly, then press Run Commands.

steps.title: Connect the screens
steps.objective: Make both buttons take people to the right screen.
steps.concept: A link sends the user to another screen after the button’s action. You need one link in each direction.
steps.expected: Both buttons now open the other screen.

expect.label: New Reminder links to New Reminder

hints: Three lines: link the first button, go to the other screen, link the second button.
Put the text inside straight quotation marks.
Copy the command from the step card exactly, then press Run Commands.

steps.title: Final style check: every colour, border, shadow and style
steps.objective: Give your screens the same colours, shapes and shadows as the model app.
steps.concept: Colours were chosen while you built each element. Now finish the whole look: every colour, background, border, corner, shadow and text style below must match the model app you tried at the start. Items you already set show a tick.
steps.expected: Your screens look exactly like the model app.
hints: Click the element on the phone first. The style box (Choose colours, borders and corners) opens by itself.
Follow the sub-steps one by one: each says which row to use and which option to click. The red dot shows where.
Text alignment and weight are in the Properties panel (right) under “Text and layout”.

steps.title: Run and test reminders
steps.objective: Create a reminder and see it in the list.
steps.concept: Choose today’s date to see the “due now” alert at the top of the list.
steps.expected: Your reminder appears in the list.

expect.name: saved:reminders

expect.fail: In the running app tap New Reminder, fill in the boxes and tap Save Reminder.

expect.name: viewed:list:reminders
expect.label: You saw it in the reminders list

subs.t: Press Run Project in the top bar
In the phone, tap New Reminder
Look at your reminder in the list

hints: Press Run Project and watch the demo.
Type a reminder, pick a date and tap Save Reminder.
Use today’s date to see the due-now alert.

objectives: Use a date picker to give each reminder a due date.
Show reminders in a list that highlights what is due.
Save reminders and tick them off.

mcqs.q: Why does the app compare a reminder's date with today's date?
a: To decide whether the reminder is due
mcqs.why: Comparing dates lets the app react to time.

mcqs.q: What is the advantage of a date picker?
a: The date is always valid and in the same format
It is smaller than a text box
mcqs.why: A picker avoids typing errors in dates.

mcqs.q: Why highlight reminders that are due?
a: It draws attention to what needs action first
mcqs.why: Visual emphasis helps users notice urgent things.

mcqs.q: Which two pieces of information make a useful reminder?
mcqs.why: A reminder is the task plus the date it matters.

mcqs.q: How does the user reach the New Reminder form?
a: A clearly labelled button linked to that screen
mcqs.why: Buttons and links are how screens connect.
